full_prompt_en: A square cubist-style digital painting shows a close frontal face assembled from overlapping angular planes of turquoise, violet, orange, red, and dark blue. The face fills nearly the entire frame, with the hairline and chin touching the upper and lower borders. The surrounding background is a compact arrangement of dark geometric facets, so there is little conventional empty space. Across the forehead, broad teal and purple triangles meet a bright orange wedge over the right eye. The eyes remain recognizable within the abstraction: dark brows and warm brown irises look outward from shadowed sockets, one set deeper beneath a heavy turquoise ridge. A long broken nose runs down the middle as connected orange and blue planes. The mouth sits low at the center, with dark angular lips, a narrow orange-red highlight, and a deep shadow beneath. Along the left side, an ear is represented by nested curved and angular shapes in coral, yellow, and teal. Cheeks and jaw fracture into sharp facets of red, violet, green, and amber rather than continuous skin. Despite the many shifts in viewpoint, the head reads as one stern, still presence. Small crosshatched strokes and subtle paperlike grain texture the colored planes; they are not perfectly flat vector blocks. Warm orange light seems to strike from the upper right, lighting one side of the forehead, nose, and cheek, while indigo and purple settle into the opposing planes. Hard edges define the major facets, but their internal texture makes the transitions feel worked by hand. There is no readable text. The overall composition is dense and confrontational, using fractured geometry and warm-cool color contrast to create volume within a nearly full-frame face.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形立体主义风格数字绘画呈现一张贴近的正面面孔，由青绿、紫、橙、红和深蓝的重叠棱角平面拼成。面孔几乎填满整个画幅，发际与下巴触及上下边框。周围背景是紧密排列的深色几何切面，几乎没有常规留白。额头上，宽阔的青绿与紫色三角形在右眼上方遇到明亮的橙色楔形。眼睛在抽象中仍可辨认：深色眉毛和暖褐虹膜从阴影眼窝望出，其中一只更深地藏在厚重的青绿眉脊下。断续的长鼻子以橙色和蓝色相连平面沿中央向下。嘴位于偏下中央，有棱角分明的深色嘴唇、一道窄橙红高光和下方深影。左侧耳朵被表现为珊瑚红、黄色和青绿色的嵌套曲形与角形。脸颊和颌线裂为红、紫、绿、琥珀的锐利切面，而非连续肌肤。尽管视点不断变化，头部仍读作一个严肃而静止的存在。细小交叉排线和轻微纸般颗粒使彩色平面有肌理，并非完全平坦的矢量色块。暖橙光似乎从右上照来，点亮一侧额头、鼻子和脸颊，靛蓝与紫色则沉入相对的平面。坚硬边缘定义主要切面，但内部肌理让过渡像手工反复处理。画面没有可读文字。整体构图密集而有对峙感，以破碎几何和冷暖色对照在几乎满幅的面孔里建立体积。
style_prompt_en: The digital cubist painting breaks a continuous subject into interlocking polygons that suggest several viewpoints at once. Saturated turquoise and blue oppose hot orange, coral, and violet, while a few very dark recesses give the overlapping pieces depth. Hard diagonal edges carry the main structure, but fine hatched strokes and faint paper grain prevent the color from feeling purely mechanical. Larger cool planes establish mass; smaller warm wedges catch attention and indicate a directional light from one side. The frame is tightly filled, with little negative space and a strong central axis held inside asymmetrical fragments. Curved motifs occasionally interrupt the angular network, keeping the geometry from becoming rigid. The overall effect is intense, sculptural, and chromatic, with volume built by the collision of colored facets rather than smooth shading.
style_prompt_zh: 这种数字立体主义绘画把连续主体拆为互相咬合的多边形，仿佛同时暗示多个视点。饱和青绿与蓝色对照炽热橙色、珊瑚红和紫色，少数极深凹处让重叠碎片有纵深。坚硬斜边承载主要结构，细密排线和轻微纸面颗粒则避免颜色显得全然机械。较大的冷色平面建立重量，较小的暖色楔形吸引注意并提示来自一侧的定向光。画框被紧密填满，留白很少，强烈的中央轴线被不对称碎片包围。弯曲纹样偶尔打断棱角网络，使几何不至僵硬。整体效果强烈、雕塑化而富于色彩，体积由彩色切面的碰撞而非平滑阴影建立。
theme_en: A face assembled from saturated angular color planes
theme_zh: 由饱和棱角彩色平面拼成的面孔
name: Cubism
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
